newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB delays launch of WBTV.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB delays launch of WBTV.

text.p: The planned November 1 launch of WBTV-The Warner Channel on British satellite broadcaster BSkyB has been delayed until further notice, Sky and WBTV said in a joint statement on Thursday.
The statement added that preparations were continuing for a launch to be announced at a later date.
"Discussions are still going on," a BSkyB spokesman said, adding he could not speculate on when the channel might launch.

There has been media speculation in recent days that the launch would be delayed as a result of an ongoing legal battle between Rupert Murdoch's News Corp and Time Warner. News Corp has a 40 percent stake in BSkyB.
Murdoch is locked in a legal battle with Time Warner, the second largest U.S. cable opeator, about whether it will carry News Corp's new 24-hour Fox News service.
